event.viltrumitecore.thanos.arrived: Thanos has arrived with all six Infinity Stones. Defeat him before time runs out — or he will snap his fingers!
event.viltrumitecore.thanos.phase.black_: Phase II: Thanos calls the Black Order down from the Sanctuary II!
event.viltrumitecore.thanos.phase.invasi: Phase III: the sky opens. The Chitauri invade Atheria!
event.viltrumitecore.thanos.phase.gauntl: Phase IV: Thanos unleashes the full power of the Gauntlet!
event.viltrumitecore.thanos.victory: Thanos falls! The Infinity Gauntlet goes dark.
event.viltrumitecore.thanos.time_up: Time is up. Thanos raises the Gauntlet…
event.viltrumitecore.thanos.gone_victory: Thanos is defeated. The universe is safe.
event.viltrumitecore.thanos.restored: Od Lagna restored the universe. Thanos has been erased from existence.
event.viltrumitecore.thanos.abandoned: No hero remained to face Thanos. He left the battlefield.
event.viltrumitecore.thanos.lost: Thanos vanished from the world. The event has ended.
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.creative_: Thanos ignores players in creative and spectator mode. Switch to survival to fight him.
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.already: The Thanos event is already running.
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.paused: Time is stopped right now. Start the event once the world is moving again.
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.no_space: There is no room for Thanos to land here.
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.not_runni: The Thanos event is not running.
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.not_fight: Thanos is not fighting right now.
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.skipped: Timer set: %s left until the snap.
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.status: Thanos: %1$s, %2$s until the snap, health %3$s, heroes %4$s, phase: %5$s, moves: %6$s
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.phase_ref: No phase change now: the war is not being fought (or the snap has begun), or the phase is unknown.
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.order_cal: The Black Order is beamed down.
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.wave_call: A Chitauri wave is called (%s invaders alive).
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.ship_stri: Orbital strike ordered on your position. Move!
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.ship_busy: The Sanctuary II cannot fire now (not over the city yet, or every gun is busy).
commands.viltrumitecore.thanos.war: War: phase %1$s; ship %2$s, %3$s strikes fired; army %4$s alive, %5$s waves, %6$s portals; Ebony Maw %7$s, Cull Obsidian %8$s; city alarm %9$s, %10$s blackouts; %11$s holds; %12$s blocks destroyed
scene.viltrumitecore.thanos.line.1: Enough. You clenched your fist — and the stars went out like candles.
scene.viltrumitecore.thanos.line.2: You called it balance. But it was only one deciding for all that lives.
scene.viltrumitecore.thanos.line.3: Listen, Titan. Every world you erased was a voice — and I am the place where every voice returns.
scene.viltrumitecore.thanos.line.4: Your stones are shards of me. They obey the one who made them, not the one who stole them.
scene.viltrumitecore.thanos.line.5: I will not undo what was fought for. The scars remain — they belong to those who stood against you.
scene.viltrumitecore.thanos.line.6: Now — return. Let existence remember itself… and forget only you.
